Public pages polish (issue #1179)

2026-11-24 — branch fix/public-pages-polish

What was done

  • /beta: text moved to messages/*.json (BetaNotice), Polish version added; existing facts only, nothing new promised. Inline styles replaced by Tailwind classes.
  • /auth/auth-code-error: uses the shared auth card and header, has an h1, translated (AuthCodeError).
  • "Changelog" / "Lista zmian" removed from the landing nav and footer, with the unused message keys.
  • /accept-invitation dead-link state: "ask your teacher for a new invitation" plus a link to sign in (replaces the link to sign-up).
  • Not done on purpose: /terms (regulamin) needs the owner's legal text.

How to test manually

  1. Run the app, open each URL below with the browser language set to Polish, then English.
  2. Check desktop (1440 px) and phone (375 px): no horizontal scroll, text fully translated.
  3. Open /accept-invitation without a token: the error state must not link to /sign-up.

Result (Playwright, dev stack): all 16 page/locale/size combinations rendered; no horizontal overflow; no changelog text on the landing page in either language.
